1722-2034-2811-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-2811-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

4770-5301-6723-6791.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2137-4478-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-4478-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

678-3899-4192-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-3899-4192-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-5086-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

573-5147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Gruul Turf.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Gruul Turf from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

413-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
413-7804--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station and Captain Kathryn Janeway trigger.
Resolve the Captain Kathryn Janeway trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat

3179-4399-4518-6097.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-6097.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1621-3375-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-4871-5686-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have attacked this turn.
You have max speed.
1263-4871-5686-6255.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1368-5223-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-5223-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6633-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5231-6602--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Repeat.

933-1367-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Blink Sanar using Conjurer's Closet. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
933-1367-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

6127-7299.description:
Cast Wrath of God by paying its mana cost, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
6127-7299.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

2743-6570-7202.description:
Cast Mnemonic Deluge by paying {6}{U}{U}{U}, exiling Kindle the Inner Flame and casting three copies of it without paying their mana costs.
Resolve the three Kindle the Inner Flame copies, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

232-1018-1235-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Skullwinder.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Skullwinder with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Skullwinder tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

57-1115-4846-5904.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
57-1115-4846-5904.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1978-2734-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-2734-7013.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1532-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1532-2292.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

659-4381-4613-6968.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-6968.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

5147-5541-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2585-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

2793-3743-5014-5089-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-5014-5089-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1495-2060-3967-5544-6431.manaNeeded: {B} if Crystalline Crawler does not have a +1/+1 counter on it
1495-2060-3967-5544-6431.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
If able, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Forsaken Miner enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Triskelion ability from step 3.
Repeat.

2403-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2403-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

273-4763-5004-6068.description:
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Cathodion.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Cathodion, targeting Koll.
When Cathodion dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Cathodion by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

997-1365-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-1365-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

204-2871-5851.manaNeeded: {8} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters and/or other creatures you control without summoning sickness
204-2871-5851.notablePrerequisites: Sorcerer Class is at least level 2.
204-2871-5851.description:
Activate any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat step 1 until you control no untapped creatures without summoning sickness, or until you have {3}{R} available, whichever comes first.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 until end of turn, and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Repeat.

1409-1418-1633-2039-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Spirit.
You have no cards in hand.
Torrential Gearhulk is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
1409-1418-1633-2039-5195.description:
Activate Torrential Gearhulk by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Torrential Gearhulk enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Torrential Gearhulk.
Resolve a Torrential Gearhulk trigger, casting Hanabi Blast from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Storm-Kiln Aritst triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, returning Hanabi Blast to your hand, and then causing you to discard Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

969-1365-3723-5112-5284.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
969-1365-3723-5112-5284.description:
Activate Mairsil using Cauldron of Souls' ability by tapping it, giving itself persist until end of turn.
Activate Mairsil using Blood Vassal's ability by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
When Mairsil dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Mairsil using Carnifex Demon's ability by paying {B} and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on each other creature.
Repeat.

296-2060-2438-2577.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
The Thirteenth Doctor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

865-2429-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least ten in any combination of Treasures and/or creatures.
865-2429-5256.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Mahadi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any creature you control, causing target player to mill cards equal to the creature's power.
Repeat step 2 until you control no creatures.
Resolve the Mahadi trigger from step 1, creating a Treasure token for each creature that died this turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches triggers, causing you to win the game.
